title: A laboratory's record that it looked for a DNA mark in a sample. Slot 0 is the call: 1 the mark was found, 0 it was not. The mark's sequence is never here: the laboratory's signed result statement (veilcore/lab-result/v2) carries only a salted SHA-256 of it, and the sequence is shown only when a dispute needs it. The laboratory signs the record. Published by VeilCore (veilcore.org).
